title: Run dialog command history
whyItMatters: The RunMRU key lists commands typed into the Run dialog, which can expose programs, paths and URLs the user launched.
notes: MRU value data is not read, only counted. Registry last-write time is unavailable per project decision D3.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan.
Delete the values in that key but keep the key itself; this empties the history.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Run dialog history for this account. The Run dialog forgets everything that was typed into it.
